word: Title: The Afternoon Rehearsal Breakdown
answer: El Colapso del Ensayo Vespertino

word: A stressed actor forgets his opening line.
answer: Un actor estresado olvida su línea inicial.

word: A calm director signals for another attempt.
answer: Un director sereno señala otro intento.

word: An exhausted dancer collapses onto the mat.
answer: Una bailarina agotada cae sobre la colchoneta.

word: A hopeful singer hums softly backstage.
answer: Un cantante esperanzado tararea suavemente entre bastidores.

word: A furious stagehand slams the heavy door.
answer: Un tramoyista furioso azota la puerta pesada.

word: We are going to energize the sleepy cast.
answer: Vamos a energizar al elenco somnoliento.

word: A relaxed violinist adjusts her shoulder rest.
answer: Una violinista relajada ajusta su soporte de hombro.

word: An annoyed drummer taps impatiently on metal.
answer: Un baterista molesto golpea impaciente el metal.

word: A proud coach praises the improved timing.
answer: Un entrenador orgulloso elogia el tiempo mejorado.

word: A tense moment freezes the entire ensemble.
answer: Un momento tenso congela a todo el conjunto.

word: We are going to reassure the embarrassed newcomer.
answer: Vamos a tranquilizar al recién llegado avergonzado.

word: An alert assistant checks the lighting cues.
answer: Un asistente alerta revisa las señales de iluminación.

word: A hopeful melody rises from the piano.
answer: Una melodía esperanzada surge del piano.

word: A bothered violinist adjusts her slipping bow.
answer: Una violinista fastidiada ajusta su arco resbaloso.

word: A sleepy technician leans against the curtain.
answer: Un técnico somnoliento se recarga en la cortina.

word: We are going to relax the stressed performers.
answer: Vamos a relajar a los artistas estresados.

word: An optimistic note brightens the rehearsal mood.
answer: Una nota optimista ilumina el ambiente del ensayo.

word: An offended actor storms off the stage.
answer: Un actor ofendido sale furioso del escenario.

word: A rested singer returns with renewed energy.
answer: Un cantante descansado regresa con energía renovada.

word: I am going to support the hopeless dancer.
answer: Voy a apoyar a la bailarina desesperada.
